description: Deterministic evaluation dataset for SOP execution-class routing with the Julia decision provider. Each case is a realistic software-engineering task description labeled with its expected class (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH). This dataset is evaluation evidence only; it does not tune the model or define routing policy.
